passwordReset.subject: 🔑 Your password reset link — Rothern
passwordReset.preview: Link for your password reset request.
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password 🔑
passwordReset.intro: You requested a password reset for your Rothern account. Click the button below to set a new password.
passwordReset.onceOnly: This link can only be used once.
passwordReset.ignoreNote: If you didn’t make this request, you can ignore this email — nothing changes in your account unless you use the link.
passwordReset.textIntro: You requested a password reset for your account.
passwordReset.textValidity: The link is valid for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and can only be used once.
passwordReset.textIgnore: If you didn’t make this request, you can ignore this email.

referralInvite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to Rothern
referralInvite.preview: {inviterName} wants to connect with you on Rothern.
referralInvite.heading: You’ve been invited to Rothern
referralInvite.intro: {inviterName} would like to connect with you to run procurement through Rothern. Rothern is a B2B procurement platform that brings quote collection, reverse auctions, orders and payment tracking together in one place.
referralInvite.autoConnect: When you sign up with this email, you are automatically connected with {inviterName} — this connection is permanent and works regardless of plan.
referralInvite.infoNote: When you sign up with this address, the connection is created automatically.
referralInvite.ignoreNote: If you weren’t expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email — no action will be taken.
referralInvite.textAbout:
Rothern is a B2B procurement platform that brings quote collection,
reverse auctions, orders and payment tracking together in one place.
referralInvite.textAutoConnect: Sign up with this address ({email}) and you will be connected with {inviterName} automatically.
referralInvite.textIgnore: If you weren’t expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
referralInvite.optOut: If you don’t want to receive such invitations, you can <optout>turn them off here with one click</optout>.

tenderExternalInvite.footnote: This email is a one-time buying request invitation sent by {inviterName} through Rothern; you have not been added to a marketing list. If you don’t want to receive such invitations, you can <optout>turn them off here with one click</optout>.
